observations: Large wooden open wardrobe with a light-colored finish.
Three vertical compartments: two with shelves and one with a hanging rail.
The unit is heavily loaded with folded and hanging clothes.
Construction appears to be particle board or MDF with a wood-effect laminate.
The back panel is visible behind some clothes.
No brand markings or labels are visible.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a shelving and hanging unit without doors.

claims.claim: can be used at home or boutique

risks.risk: Structural sagging or bowing of shelves under heavy load.
risks.proof: Photo of the unit completely empty.

risks.risk: Surface damage, scratches, or peeling laminate hidden by clothes.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of empty shelves and side panels.
Video showing the unit being shaken to test for wobbling.

proof_requests: Photos of the wardrobe completely empty to check for shelf sagging and surface condition.
Clear photo of the back panel and joints.
response.reason: The item is a standard open wardrobe. Although clothes hide the exact condition of the surfaces, it can be priced as a generic used furniture item in fair condition.
